description: Moves one or more slides to a new position (batchUpdate updateSlidesPosition). slide_object_ids must appear in their current deck order with no duplicates; insertion_index is the 0-based position BEFORE the move is applied (moving a slide down: index counts with the slide still in its old place). Use list_slides to see the current order first.

insertion_index.description: 0-based target position, evaluated before the slides are removed from their old places.

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

slide_object_ids.description: The slides to move, listed in their current presentation order.

name: move_slides
title: Move slides
